question: What is the maximum normal working week?
reference_answer: 45 hours in one week (also max 8 hours a day, 5 hours without a 30-minute break, and a spread-over of 10 hours).

question: How long is the paid maternity leave?
reference_answer: An eligible period of not less than 98 consecutive days per confinement; allowance conditions apply (90 days employed in the 9 months before confinement).

question: How much notice must be given to terminate a contract of service if the contract says nothing?
reference_answer: Not less than 4 weeks (under 2 years of service), 6 weeks (2 to under 5 years), 8 weeks (5 years or more).

question: How many days of paid sick leave is an employee entitled to?
reference_answer: Without hospitalisation: 14 / 18 / 22 days a year by length of service (under 2 / 2 to 5 / over 5 years); 60 days if hospitalisation is necessary.

question: How many days of annual leave does an employee with 3 years of service get?
reference_answer: 12 days for every 12 months of continuous service (2 years or more but less than 5).

question: How many days of paternity leave can a married male employee take?
reference_answer: 7 consecutive days per confinement (up to five confinements); needs 12 months with the same employer and notice of the pregnancy.

question: By when must wages be paid?
reference_answer: Not later than the seventh day after the last day of the wage period (s.19(1)); rest day / holiday / overtime pay by the last day of the next wage period.

question: Is there a limit on how much an employer can deduct from my wages in a month?
reference_answer: Total deductions in a month shall not exceed 50% of wages earned, with exceptions in s.24(9).

question: Can an employee ask to change their working hours or place of work?
reference_answer: Yes: flexible working arrangement; employer must approve or refuse within 60 days and state the ground for any refusal.

question: Can an employer dismiss a pregnant employee?
reference_answer: It is an offence to terminate a pregnant employee except for wilful breach (s.13(2)), misconduct (s.14(1)) or closure of the business; burden of proof is on the employer.

question: How many paid public holidays is an employee entitled to?
reference_answer: Eleven gazetted public holidays, five of which are compulsory (National Day, Agong's Birthday, Ruler's Birthday or Federal Territory Day, Workers' Day, Malaysia Day).

question: Can I be forced to work on my rest day and how is it paid?
reference_answer: No compulsion except shift work or emergencies (s.60(1), s.60A(2)); pay rates for rest-day work are in s.60(3). Every employee gets one rest day a week (s.59).

question: What is the overtime rate and when does work count as overtime?
reference_answer: At least 1.5 times the hourly rate (s.60A(3)); overtime is hours beyond normal hours per day; rest day and public holiday pay are separate rates (s.60, s.60D).

question: My employer makes me work 12 hours a day. Is this allowed?
reference_answer: Normally no: 8 hours a day / 45 a week (s.60A(1)), up to 9 hours a day if other days are shorter; hours beyond normal hours are overtime; no employer may require more than 12 hours in a day except in emergencies (s.60A(7)).

question: Can my employer dismiss me for misconduct without any inquiry?
reference_answer: Section 14(1) allows dismissal without notice for misconduct only 'after due inquiry'; suspension during inquiry is limited to two weeks with at least half wages (s.14(2)).

question: I have been absent for three days without telling my employer. Can they treat my contract as broken?
reference_answer: An employee is deemed to have broken the contract if continuously absent more than two consecutive working days without prior leave or reasonable excuse (s.15(2)).
